fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX (NASDAQ: SPCX) has prompted analysts to significantly raise price targets following CEO Elon Musk's forecast of annual operating income of $50B–$1T by 2027, with Raymond James setting a price target of $800.
fields.summary_ko.1: SpaceX is leveraging AI infrastructure rental revenue as a major growth driver aiming to recover investment within one year, with aggressive capex plans targeting 13 gigawatts of computing capacity by end of 2027.
